Sequential vs concurrent asynchronous
work

Independent asynchronous operations can be started together and awaited with Promise.all. Dependent
operations must wait for prerequisite results. Concurrent I/O does not imply parallel JavaScript on the main
thread.
එක request එJක් result එක අJනක් request එකට ඕJන් නම් sequential. Requests Jදක independent නම් Jදකම එකට පටන්Jගෙන Promise.all() භාවිත කරන්න පුළුවන්. ඒක network waiting time අඩු කරන්න පුළුවන්.

Interview question: When should you avoid Promise.all?

Answer: When operations depend on each other, or when concurrency must be limited to respect
resource limits.
Practice: Rewrite two sequential independent awaits using Promise.all.
